extDescription.message: Share selected browser tabs with your Murage bots and keep control with Pause and Stop.

overlayAria.message: $BOT$ is using this tab. Pause or stop it here.

spDebugNote.message: While $BOT$ works, Chrome shows a bar saying Murage for Chrome started debugging this browser. That is Chrome telling you an extension can act in your tabs. Pressing Cancel on that bar pauses $BOT$.

spUpdateWaiting.message: Murage for Chrome will update when $BOT$ finishes this step.

spOldExtension.message: Update Murage for Chrome to get the new controls.

spOldApp.message: Update Murage on this computer to use this version of Murage for Chrome.

spHintStep.message: $BOT$ asks before each action that changes a site.

spHintTask.message: One card per site, then $BOT$ works through the task.

spHintFull.message: No cards for ordinary actions. Anything only you can do still comes back to you.

spShareHint.message: Only tabs you share here belong to this bot. Moving a tab into its group does not share it.

spSetupBody.message: Open Murage on this computer and turn on the browser companion in Browser settings.

spBodyWorking.message: Working in the tabs you shared.

spBodyPaused.message: Tabs stay private until you resume.

spBodyStopped.message: This task was stopped. Ask the bot to start again in a new conversation.

spBodyReconnect.message: Waiting for Murage to reconnect this bot.

spErrHostOffline.message: Open Murage, then check the connection again.

spErrSiteDenied.message: Murage asked you to allow this site. Allow it there, then press Share again.

spErrHumanHandover.message: This site needs you to use it directly.

spErrBindingInactive.message: Resume this bot in Murage before sharing tabs.

spErrTabOwned.message: Another bot already owns this tab.

spErrUnknownBinding.message: Start a browser task in Murage first.

spErrBindingStopped.message: This task was stopped. Ask the bot to start again in a new conversation.

spErrGeneric.message: The browser action could not finish. Check the connection and try again.

overlayYourTurn.message: Your turn: $BOT$ is waiting for you

spBodyYourTurn.message: Do this step yourself in the browser, then let your bot carry on.

spRecoveryReshare.message: Murage for Chrome started fresh. Share your tabs again to continue.

spErrHandoffUseContinue.message: Your bot is waiting for you. Press Continue when you have finished the step.

spErrNotHandoff.message: Your bot is not waiting for you right now, so there is nothing to continue.

spErrIncognitoDenied.message: Murage for Chrome does not work in private windows. Open the site in a normal window, then share it.

spErrPersistenceFailed.message: Chrome could not save your changes. Try again in a moment.

spErrUpdateRequired.message: This profile was saved by a newer Murage for Chrome. Update the extension to continue.

spErrStorageUnavailable.message: Chrome storage could not be read. Restart Chrome, then share your tabs again.
